text: Ten-year-old twins Elias and Lukas welcome their mother home to their isolated lakeside house, [her face hidden in bandages after cosmetic surgery|images|wounded and changing bodies]. She keeps the blinds shut through summer, [imposes a strict rule of silence|images|sounds, smells and silence], ignores Lukas and lashes out at Elias, until the boys suspect [the woman beneath the bandages is an impostor|threat|impostors and doubles]. An old photograph of her beside a similar woman in identical clothes seems like proof, and the twins tie her to the bed to make her confess.
